The window checked the records: #249 (2847b490) already puts a reviewer\\u0027s tests on a branch of her own and offers to stack it on the pull request; #81 (merged from Windows as PR #264 on 2026-09-07) declares the stacked edge on a local task and makes the child dispatchable when the parent reaches Delivered in the local store; #82 (f260ebf6 here, a8e7f480 on Windows) adds checkpoint rebases and the dead-parent park. The gap is that a reviewer\\u0027s node never holds the parent\\u0027s run, so the parent never reaches Delivered locally and the child never dispatches.
